component.name: Microsoft 365 (Unofficial)
component.summary: Unofficial desktop client for Microsoft 365 with native OneDrive sync

description.p: Microsoft 365 for Linux (Unofficial) provides a seamless desktop integration for Microsoft 365 web applications combined with native background synchronization powered by OneDrive for Linux.

ul.li: Integrated access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Outlook, and OneDrive
Continuous background OneDrive synchronization using inotify filesystem monitoring
Direct local file editing in Office Online via isolated managed cloud uploads
Atomic file writes with real-time web renaming detection
System tray indicator and background autostart capabilities

description.p: Note: This is an unofficial community project and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Microsoft Corporation.
Initial stable release featuring native OneDrive sync and Office Online integration.
